_comment: Copy this file to secrets.json (gitignored) and fill in the values. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every value comes from 1Password, vault k8s-secrets-dev, unless noted. Ask Ive if an item is missing there.
_OKTA_INTERNAL_SECRET: Okta_InternalServices_Secret for the dev02 AWS server (client 0oa2ta051fvbwMCpr0h8). Used by libertine to call other services.
_NEXTAUTH_SECRET: Frontend NextAuth cookie encryption key. Any long random string works locally; the shared dev value is in 1Password.
_NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_SECRET: Client secret of the ROPC identity client (ropc_client) used by the frontend against the dev02 identity server.
_NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSETS_BASE: Base URL of the static assets bucket (login page image etc.). Not secret, but environment specific; copy from the Vercel dev02 project or a colleague.
_OKTA_CLIENT_SECRET: Client secret of the frontend's Okta app on the dev02 server (client 0oa2ta051dgJQg8jd0h8). Without it Okta login ends in 'We could not start verification'.
_MONGO_BRIDGE_DEV_AUTH_TOKEN: Optional. Token for the news/Mongo bridge; leave blank if you do not work on news.
_AZURE_AD: Optional. Only for the Azure AD SSO login path; leave blank for Okta email-code login.
_SERVICES: Below: only needed when a backend service runs locally (devenv up --local <name>). Which ones a service needs depends on its template; devenv tells you when a required one is blank.
_DB_PASSWORD: Password of SQL user 'libertine' on mssql-internal.test.mavera.claims.verisk.com (dev02 database). Required for every service with a database.
_CRYPTO: CryptoSettings IV and key shared by evaluation and document services (field encryption). Optional for a smoke test, needed for real case data.
_SMB: Legacy file share used by evaluation-service for old case files. Leave blank unless you need those.
_S3: Object storage for document-service (dev02 bucket). Needed to open documents through a local document-service.
_MAIL_SMS: notification-service only; running it locally is blocked until DSS-5587 adds a mail sink.
_LEGACY: Pre-Okta internal-services secret and system account; only templates that still carry $InternalServicesSettings_* use them.
_OKTA_INTEGRATION_CLIENT_ID: integration only: client id of the public Integration API's Okta app on the dev02 server (not in the fleet compose). Blank boots the service with external auth disabled.
